scope: canonical DMC3 HD SCM serialized/runtime reverse; writer/integration/original-game acceptance excluded

completion.rule: Every serialized/runtime domain has a typed/structural semantic, a terminal preservation disposition, or a rejected hypothesis. Human-friendly names are not required for preservation-only fields.
non_claims: original dmc3.exe acceptance of arbitrary authored SCM

header.texture_slot_count: EXE_AND_CORPUS_CONFIRMED serialized mirror; external companion is runtime authority
header.resource_code_14: CORPUS_CONFIRMED arithmetic decomposition + EXE_CONFIRMED manager+0xE4 carry; neutral class labels terminal

object.flags_10: EXE_CONFIRMED projection with per-bit terminal dispositions

object_flags.low_nibble: EXE_CONFIRMED helper/render mode and forced alpha-control path
object_flags.0x00020000: EXE_CONFIRMED runtime flag plus unit-vector initialization
object_flags.0x00100000: EXE_CONFIRMED legacy GS TEST_1 AREF 0/16 and ZBUF_1 ZMSK 1/0 selector in shared helper path
object_flags.0x00200000: PRESERVED_UNDECODED; corpus-observed/runtime-preserved with whole-image candidate provenance rejection
object_flags.0x00004000: EXE_CONFIRMED legacy GS TEX1 nearest(0) versus linear(0x60)
object_flags.all_other_bits: PRESERVED_UNDECODED if encountered; exact source preservation is mandatory until an independent SCM-provenanced consumer promotes a stronger semantic

mesh.uv_20: EXE_AND_CORPUS_CONFIRMED signed i16 fixed point scale 1/4096

topology.all_other_flag_bits: PRESERVED_UNDECODED if encountered; only bit 0x02 is currently promoted to a topology semantic

shell_10_1f: EXE_CONFIRMED dormant/no effect in audited model path

transform.translation_magnitude_0c: EXE_AND_CORPUS_CONFIRMED Euclidean length; excluded from homogeneous W

rejected_or_superseded: object+0x01 is only an unknown classification byte
object flag 0x00004000 has only opaque 0/0x60 descriptor semantics
object flag 0x00100000 has only opaque 0x5000D/0x5010D semantics
nearby 0x00200000 masks prove the SCM object bit21 meaning
header+0x14 needs an invented gameplay label before reverse completion
